column1: # Mapping table for FactoryCounts (Phase 16). Columns are tab separated.
# severity <word> <class>            normalises a reviewer severity word to blocker, major, minor, advisory
# alias <word> <role>                a file-name word that stands for a role (for names without the role name).
#                                    Aliases apply to document file names only. Finding text and headings match
#                                    full role names, or a role or alias inside an explicit "Owner: <role>" tag.
#                                    first matching row wins; the path is relative to the phase directory
#   role   : work-order, report, review, decision, ratification, human-commands, evidence, ignore
#   parser : none, auto, heading-bullets, numbered-severity, id-bullet
#   round  : a number, "auto" (digits after round, review or verdict-round in the file name) or "-" (1)
#   idMap  : id letter to severity for the id-bullet parser, e.g. K=blocker,M=major; "-" uses the default
# Where the formats drift between phases the drift is handled here, not in code:
#   phase 12  bullets "- H1 (High)." with agent headings (id-bullet)
#   phase 15  severity headings Blockers, Major, Minor, Advisory with K/M/m/a ids (heading-bullets)
# A review file that yields no finding is listed under reviewFilesWithoutParsedFindings; add a row for it.
